tytul: Can I Use Multiple Accounts on Allegro?
naglowek: Multiple Accounts on Allegro
tekst:
Yes, you can have multiple accounts, as long as you register them with your correct and genuine personal data.
You cannot use these accounts to violate our rules. You cannot:
buy in your own listings
outbid your own purchase offers in transactions by other customers on the site
issue sales ratings for your own listings
use additional accounts to bypass payment and commission systems and avoid payments.
These rules also apply to accounts of individuals who live together, work together or use the same computer (especially family members, colleagues, and friends). To avoid any doubts, such individuals should not buy and sell from each other on Allegro.
If you use additional accounts
contrary to these rules
, we may
suspend all your accounts - including your first, main account.
If we suspended your previous account,
you cannot create a new one
until we agree to allow you to register again. First, clarify the blockage of your previous account.

tytul: What is two-step login and how does it help protect your account?
naglowek: How does two-step login work?
tekst:
How does two-step login work
Two-step login is an additional security feature that protects your account from being used by someone else. It verifies your login by using one-time codes.
When you have this security feature enabled, during login, we ask you for:
login and password
one-time code, which:
is sent to you via SMS
or
can be generated in an app.
This way, even if someone steals your account password on Allegro – they won't be able to log in, because the one-time code is only yours.
To make two-step login more convenient, you can also add your devices to trusted ones and avoid entering the code every time you log in on them.
Check how to use this option.

If you have the option of
login by phone number
enabled on your account, you cannot enable two-step login on it.

Select the option to use the app for code generation and click [next].
Choose the type of device you will use for code generation and click [next].

Once you complete all steps, click [next].
Enter the code from the app and click [enable].
For added security, also enter the phone number where you want to receive notifications in case of a login attempt from an unrecognized device.

naglowek: What Are Trusted Devices?
tekst:
What Are Trusted Devices
If you are the only person using a particular device and often log in to your Allegro account from it, you can add it to your trusted devices. Trusted devices are a list of devices you've chosen to trust, where we won't ask for a one-time code when you log in.

Thanks to this, we'll only require a code when you use an unfamiliar device or when someone tries to hack into your account. On a daily basis, you'll log in quickly and conveniently.

If you clear your browser cookies or change its settings, we won't recognize your device as trusted anymore. In this situation, we will ask for a one-time code when you log in. We'll also do this if you use a different internet browser or a private browsing mode (incognito).

tytul: What is a Junior Account and How to Create One
naglowek: Create a Junior Account and Start Shopping and Selling on Allegro
tekst:
A Junior Account is a special type of account that allows you to buy and sell items on Allegro while you're under 18 years old. You can also leave reviews for sellers and products, ensuring your transactions are safe and legal. A Junior Account protects you from the consequences of unknowingly breaking the rules, such as when you want to buy or sell an item that's not suitable for minors.
Once you turn 18, your Junior Account will automatically be upgraded to a regular account.
How to Register for a Junior Account
If you're between 13 and 18 years old and have your 18th birthday ahead of you, make sure your parents or legal guardians agree to your Allegro account.
In the registration form, check the box indicating you're under 18 and enter your date of birth. Your account will be set to Junior status.
What are the Restrictions on a Junior Account
You can use the basic functions of Allegro, but before you turn 18, you'll have limited access to certain services.
A Junior Account has a limit of 50 zł on fees for listing items.
When you exceed this limit, you must first pay your bill in the Payments section to continue listing items.
For security reasons, with a Junior Account you cannot:
share your account with a spouse
become a Super Seller
use installment payments

tytul: Why can't I see information about purchases or offers on my account?
tekst:
If after logging in, you can't see information about your purchases or favorite offers, make sure you're on the correct Allegro account. If you're using automatic login and password prompts during the log-in process, your device might have suggested you use someone else's account details.
What if you can't see purchase information
If you can't see information about a specific purchase in the
My Purchases
section, it might be hidden. You can't unhide or recover it yourself.
To make your purchase visible again in the
My Purchases
section, please contact us. In your message, specify which purchase you're referring to – for example, what was the item or the seller's login.
Purchase details are typically included in the notification we send after each purchase. Try to find this notification in your email inbox.
What if you can't see an offer in Favorites
If an offer you added to the Favorites section is no longer visible on Allegro, it might mean the offer ended more than 60 days ago.
If the offer is no longer visible on Allegro, we can provide you with basic information:
the title and offer number

seller's login.

tytul: Why do I need to confirm my data?
naglowek: Why do we need to confirm your data?
tekst:
In justified cases, when:

- you violate site rules
- you change account details
- you try to recover access to your account
- we want to verify your identity

we may ask you to provide additional documents.

What documents we may ask you for
If you have a regular account – we will ask you for an unaltered photo of your ID document and/or a selfie, i.e., a photo you take yourself with your phone or web camera.
If you have a business account – we will ask you for unaltered photos that confirm the existence of the company, for example: a document assigning the NIP, REGON and/or a selfie, i.e., a photo you take yourself with your phone or web camera.
Why we ask for document photos
We need them solely to verify the authenticity of the information provided in the registration form. Sending a document
is voluntary.
However, it may be a condition to continue the cooperation between you and Allegro.
What happens to photos of your documents
We will delete them once we confirm that your data is correct.

tytul: Additional seller data verification on a regular account - what is it and how it looks
naglowek: Additional seller data verification on a regular account: what it is and how it works
tekst:
From time to time, the Allegro Finance payment operator has a legal obligation to re-verify a company's data. They may then ask you to confirm your identity and send additional information, such as company registration documents.
This additional
seller data verification on the Allegro site
proceeds similarly to account registration and activation. Therefore, we can complete some of the data for you, which will make the verification process easier and faster for you.

What triggers the need for additional verification
The requirement for additional verification is based on the provisions of art. 34 and art. 35 of the Act of March 1, 2018, on preventing money laundering and financing terrorism (J.O. of 2023, item 1124, as amended).

How often are data re-verified
The Allegro Finance payment operator can re-verify data at any time, but typically does so no more than once every 3 years. In some cases, account re-verification may occur more frequently.
How much time you have to complete the re-verification
The time you have to complete the re-verification depends on whether the operator considers the matter urgent or standard. The accelerated mode is only 7 days, but usually, you will have 60 days to verify your account. If you do not verify your account within this time, we will block your withdrawals. In the notification you receive from us, and in the message displayed in several tabs, you will find the exact deadline by which you need to complete the verification.

tytul: Additional Seller Data Verification on a Standard Account - What It Is and How It Works
naglowek: Additional Seller Data Verification on a Standard Account - What It Is and How It Works
tekst:
When you receive a notification from us and see the message we display across several tabs, you'll find the exact information on when you need to verify your data.
During this time, you can still sell and withdraw funds from your sales.
However, if your verification requires a change to your payment account number, you can only withdraw funds to the old account until the verification of your new bank account begins.
What if you don't verify on time
Please submit your documents as soon as possible. If you do so shortly before the required verification deadline, the operator may not have time to check them.
If you fail to verify on time or do not verify at all, we will block the withdrawal of your funds.
The block will be removed when you verify again.

The block applies to all accounts linked to the same NIP (National Identification Number).

During verification, we check the data of the company linked to one NIP or another tax number. If you do not verify, it will affect all accounts connected to that number.
How the Re-verification Process Looks on the Allegro Site
The re-verification process is similar to registering and activating an account, but it's shorter and simpler. You won't need to set up sales terms, for example.
When the operator informs us that your company's data is being re-verified and that they need additional information from you, we will notify you by email. You will also see a specific message.

tytul: How to Activate Sales and Payments on a Regular Account
naglowek: Activate Sales and Payments on Your Regular Account
tekst:
Do you want to start selling on Allegro or Allegro Lokalnie? To receive payments from buyers, you need to activate the Allegro Finance service. This way, your money will quickly be transferred to your bank account.
How to Activate Sales
Go to the
Payment Settings
section.
Enter your details: your name, surname, and address.
Provide the bank account number (IBAN) to which you want to receive money from sales. If you provide a foreign account number, we will also ask you for the bank's name and SWIFT code.
Check if everything is correct and click [make a transfer].
How to Verify the Bank Account
We need to be sure that you are providing a bank account that belongs to you. Therefore, when you activate the account, we will also ask you to verify the bank account. Depending on the account you provide, you will verify it:
speedily via a pay-by-link transfer
traditionally via a regular bank transfer.

The data for the verification transfer must be
identical
to the data you enter in the Allegro form.

Verification via Pay-by-link Transfer
In the account activation form, click [make a transfer]. We will redirect you to the appropriate bank.
Confirm the transfer for 1 zł.
Verification via Traditional Bank Transfer
In the account activation form, click [make a transfer]. We will display the transfer details to you.
Log in directly to your bank and make a transfer of 1 zł to the data we provide.

tytul: How to activate sales and payouts on a regular account
naglowek: Activate sales and payouts on your regular account
tekst: To activate sales and payouts on your regular account, follow these steps: 1. Log into your regular account on Allegro. 2. Go to the “Selling” section and select “Activate Sales”. 3. Choose the payment method you prefer: Allegro Smart! or Allegro Pay. 4. Enter your bank account details. 5. Click on “Next”. 6. We will send you a verification code to your phone number. 7. Enter the verification code on the website. 8. We will send you a verification transfer of 1 PLN. 9. Log into your bank and send the verification transfer of 1 PLN. 10. We will automatically return the 1 PLN verification fee once your verification is complete. 11. Return to the Allegro website and check the status of your verification. 12. If your verification is successful, you will see a confirmation message and be redirected to the “Payment Settings” page. 13. Your payouts will be processed in PLN, even if your bank account is in a different currency. 14. If you encounter any issues during the verification process, you can return to the “Payment Settings” page and click on “Retry payment” or change the bank account number for payments to a different one. 15. If you want to change your name or other personal details on your account, you can do so in specific cases in the “Account Details” section. After we confirm the change, you will need to make a new verification transfer. 16. You can change the bank account for payouts at any time: 1. Go to the “Payment Settings” page. 2. Click on “Change” next to your current bank account. 3. Follow the prompts to update your bank details. 4. Make a new verification transfer to complete the change. 5. Your payouts will be processed using the new bank account details until the change is confirmed.

tytul: How to Log into Allegro
naglowek: How to Log in with a Passkey
tekst:
How to Log in with a Passkey
A passkey is a secure way to log in, so you don't have to create a separate password. You log into Allegro the same way you usually unlock your device – for example, with a fingerprint, facial scan, or PIN code.
How it works
When you set up a passkey, we establish a secure connection between your Allegro account and the device you're using. During login, you simply unlock your device using the method you've set and confirm your identity in this way.
Most verification occurs locally on your device. The only thing that reaches us is confirmation that you've succeeded.
We don't have access to data such as your PIN, fingerprint, or facial scan. This gives you greater security and convenience.

If you want, you can still use the other login methods on a particular device – even when you have passkey login enabled.

When you can use passkeys
To log in using passkeys, you need:
a current version of one of the popular browsers, such as Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Opera, or Microsoft Edge
a secure password manager, such as Apple Keychain or Google Password Manager – these programs are often pre-installed by the device manufacturer.

If your password manager uses the cloud, you'll be able to log in this way even on multiple devices.

To safely disable this login method, remove the access key both from your Allegro account and from your device.

Make sure you're entering your login details correctly. Check that you're not using Caps Lock (typing in all capital letters) or the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Shift (which switches y and z).

If one login method doesn't work, try another. For example, if you can't log in with your login and password, try using your phone.

This number might be different from the one you provide in your account details—edit it separately. If you can't log in because of this, please contact us.

After
five unsuccessful login attempts,
Allegro's app will be blocked. We'll automatically unblock it if you log in with the correct details to your Allegro account in a browser. You can use a browser on your phone or computer.

If none of these solutions work,
contact our support team.

If you can't log in to your Allegro account, don't worry! We've got you covered with a few simple steps to help you regain access.

Go to the login page and in the section "Set up with:" select the phone number you want to use and click [next].

Enter the email address or login you use on Allegro and click [next].
In the section "Set up with:" select the email address you want to use and click [next].
Click [go to mail] and open the message we sent you.
Click the link you find in that message.
Set a new password and click [save and log in].

Learn more [here].

### Additional security measures
If you're logging in from a new device or location, the system may ask for additional SMS verification.

### What to do if you still can't access your account
If none of these steps work, click [Contact us] below this article. Our customer support team will be happy to assist you further.

**Notifications** section in the app, you can manage the notifications you receive from us. You can choose what kind of notifications you want to receive and from which services. For example, you can select to receive notifications only about offers, about events, or about new messages from other users.

**What to do if you're not receiving notifications on your phone**

If you're not receiving notifications from us on your phone, there are a few things you can try:
1. **Check your phone's settings**: Make sure that notifications from the Allegro app are enabled. You can usually find this setting in the app's settings or in your phone's main settings.
2. **Check your phone's notification settings**: Make sure that notifications from the Allegro app are allowed. This setting is usually found in your phone's main settings, in the section for app permissions.
3. **Restart your phone**: Sometimes, a simple restart can resolve issues with notifications.

**How to enable notifications from the Allegro app on your phone**

Here's a general guide on how to enable notifications from the Allegro app on your phone. However, the exact steps may vary depending on your device, its operating system, or model.

1. **Go to your phone's settings**: You can usually find this by tapping on the gear icon in the app drawer or on the home screen.
2. **Find the app settings**: This is often located in a section called **Apps**, **Application Management**, or **Device Administration**. The exact name may vary depending on your device.
3. **Find the Allegro app**: You can usually search for it in the app list or by typing in its name in the search bar.
4. **Open the Allegro app's settings**: Once you've found the app, you can usually open its settings by tapping on it and then selecting **Settings**, **Permissions**, or **Notifications**.
5. **Enable notifications**: Look for a setting that says **Notifications**, **Allow Notifications**, or something similar. Tap on it to enable notifications from the Allegro app.
6. **Adjust additional settings**: Some devices may have additional settings for notifications, such as customizing the sound or vibration. If you see these, you can adjust them to your liking.

If you're still having trouble, please let us know! We're here to help. You can contact our support team through the app or at allegro.com.pl.

tytul: What Rights Do You Have Under the Digital Services Act?
tekst:
The Digital Services Act (DSA) is a EU regulation that affects the rules for using online platforms like Allegro. Its aim is to improve the safety of online activities, among other things.
Get to know the legal measures listed in this regulation. You can use them to protect yourself in dispute situations—such as when you disagree with our decision or believe we have violated the provisions of the Act in some way.
You can choose any of the methods below or use several independently in any order.
What legal measures arise from the Digital Services Act
1. Appeal against a decision
If you believe we have made an unjust decision in your case, you can appeal that decision. You can do so within 6 months of the moment we informed you of it. This applies to decisions we made regarding:
receiving a complaint about content that violates the law or Allegro's terms and conditions
removing content, limiting its visibility, or making it inaccessible
suspending or ending service provision
suspending or closing an account
suspending, ending, or otherwise limiting the monetization options for content you provided.
In each of these cases, you can contact us. To file an appeal, use this form. In it, write why you disagree

tytul: What rights do you have under the Digital Services Act?
tekst:
If you have any concerns related to the Digital Services Act (DSA), you can reach out to us. To file an appeal, use
this form
. In it, explain why you disagree with our decision and try to provide a detailed justification.
We will review your appeal and consider all arguments. Based on this, we will evaluate whether our initial decision should be reversed. We will notify you of the outcome of the appeal.
2. Out-of-Court Dispute Resolution
You have the right to seek assistance from any
certified out-of-court dispute resolution body
. You can do this regardless of whether you have previously appealed to us.
3. Right to a Court
Decisions we have made in your case can be appealed to a court. You can do this regardless of whether you have previously appealed to us directly or used out-of-court dispute resolution.
4. Right to File a Complaint with the Digital Services Act Coordinator
If you believe our actions violate the Digital Services Act, you can also file a complaint against us with the Digital Services Act Coordinator.
Additional Options from Other Laws
The Digital Services Act is not the only law that protects users online. In disputed situations, you can also use legal remedies available to you under other regulations. Get to know some of them and check what else you can do.

tytul: When Can We Suspend Your Account or Limit Its Functions
naglowek: Important Information
tekst:
Important Information
In certain situations, if you do not comply with our rules, we may suspend your account or limit its functions. Depending on how you violate the
Allegro Terms and Conditions
, we may:
notify or warn you via email
restrict your access to certain functions
ask you to confirm your identity or fulfill the agreement, and condition your further use of Allegro on this
suspend one, several, or all of your accounts.
You can find details of our actions, among other places, in articles 2.12 and 8.4 of the Allegro Terms and Conditions.
We can suspend or limit the functions of your account if:
you share your account with others
you bid on or purchase offers you or people you know have posted
you send spam or offensive messages
you provide incomplete or false contact details (name, company, address, phone number)
the account user has changed (you can only do this in the case of transferring a corporate account along with the company – with our approval)
you do not finalize purchases
you purchase solely with the intention of harming the seller
you violate the rules of our promotions, programs, or services
or in any other way you seriously violate the Allegro Terms and Conditions or do so repeatedly despite our previous notifications.

tytul: When Can We Suspend Your Account or Limit Its Functions
naglowek: Introduction
tekst:
Introduction

You will receive a notification email when we suspend your account or limit its functions.

If you don't know why your account isn't fully active and you want to clarify this, please contact us.

When we suspend your account, we automatically cancel your purchase offers in auctions.

tytul: When can we suspend your account or limit its functions
naglowek: Prohibited Account Sharing
tekst:
Prohibited Account Sharing
Personal (private) accounts can only be used by the person who registered them.
Therefore, you cannot share your account with others or use someone else's account. If someone else has been using your account, we may block it.
Personal accounts are non-transferable - they cannot be passed on to third parties.
As the owner of an Allegro account, you are fully responsible for all actions taken through that account.
Therefore, keep your account password confidential. If you knowingly or through carelessness allow another person to gain access to your account, and they violate the law or Allegro's Terms and Conditions - you bear the consequences of that situation.

Example: if someone from your family has access to your account and uses it to artificially inflate prices in their listings - we may suspend all your accounts.

tytul: When Can We Suspend Your Account or Limit Its Functions
naglowek: Prohibited Price Fluctuations and Buying in Your Own Offers
tekst:
Prohibited Price Fluctuations and Buying in Your Own Offers
On Allegro, you cannot:
buy in your own offers and participate in your own auctions
buy and participate in auctions of people with whom you have close relationships (family, roommates, friends)
buy in other people's offers if you do not intend to pay for them.
This ban also applies when you intend to withdraw your purchase offer.
Such actions can lead to:
artificially inflating prices
misrepresenting the actual interest in an offer
obtaining positive ratings and comments for a fictitious transaction.
Price fluctuations in auctions are an unfair action towards people who are genuinely interested in purchasing a product, as it forces them to pay a higher amount for the item.

tytul: When can we suspend your account or limit its features
naglowek: Prohibited content in correspondence within Allegro
tekst:
Prohibited content in correspondence within Allegro
We care that communication between buyers and sellers takes place in a friendly, cultural, and professional atmosphere. Therefore, when sending or receiving a message, stick to the following rules.
Prohibited messages from sellers
Sellers, in particular, cannot:
propose to you the purchase of products that cannot be listed, such as weapons or pornography
propose transactions outside of Allegro, using phrases like:
“buying directly will be cheaper”
“don’t click, just call”
“order by email”
provide addresses of websites that:
advertise activities conducted outside of Allegro
mediate sales outside of Allegro
ask for support for charitable purposes
use profanity or expressions that may offend the recipient.
Prohibited messages to sellers
In messages to sellers, for example, you cannot:
request to finalize a purchase outside of Allegro
propose cooperation or transactions outside of Allegro
request support for charitable purposes
use profanity or expressions that may offend the recipient.
Learn more:
how to report prohibited content in correspondence
how to stay safe online
.

If a seller agrees to lower the price of a product for you, make sure that the purchase and payment at the agreed price proceed securely and within the platform.

tytul: When Can We Suspend Your Account or Limit Its Functions
naglowek: Prohibited Content in Correspondence Within Allegro
tekst:

If a seller agrees to lower the price of a product for you, make sure that the purchase and payment at the agreed price take place within Allegro. To do this, the seller can edit the price in the offer or post a new one. This way, your purchases will proceed safely.

tytul: When Can We Suspend or Limit Your Account
naglowek: Can You Create a New Account When the Previous One Is Suspended
tekst:
Can You Create a New Account When the Previous One Is Suspended
If your account is suspended and you want to register a new one, you need our permission. To do this,
write to us
to clarify the suspension of your previous account.
If you do not clarify the suspension of your previous account and still manage to register and activate a new account, this does not mean you have our permission to register it. It will be registered in violation of our rules, which means we can suspend it at any time.
In the case of suspension of one of your accounts due to serious violations of our rules, we may also block your other accounts - even if they were registered before the block.
After the suspension of an account, you cannot use another person's account
and, even more so, you cannot register accounts on behalf of other people. If we suspend an account of one of several people who are connected (for example, they live together or have the same IP address of their computer),
we do not automatically block the accounts of the remaining individuals.
However, if we notice that the owner of the suspended account is using accounts of other people, we may block them.
In the case of an exceptionally serious violation of our rules, we may completely block the possibility of logging into Allegro, and in special cases, we may limit access from a specific computer or IP address.
Ending the agreement with the service does not mean that you can create another account if you do not clarify the reasons for the block on the previous one.

tytul: When Can We Suspend Your Account or Limit Its Functions
naglowek: Can You Create a New Account While the Previous One Is Suspended
tekst: You can create a new account while the previous one is suspended, but you may not be able to open another account until you explain the reasons for the previous account being blocked.

tytul: When can we suspend your account or limit its features
naglowek: What features can you use if your account is suspended
tekst:
What features can you use if your account is suspended
When an account is suspended, you only have access to those features that will help you complete purchases made before the suspension or contact sellers.
Even with a suspended account, you have access to
:
payments
seller details
contact form for us
post-purchase support in the
Discussions
.
With a suspended account, you cannot, among other things
:
bid or buy
rate a seller
write product reviews.

tytul: RODO - Jak Allegro spełnia obowiązki administratorów danych osobowych
naglowek: RODO: Jak Allegro spełnia obowiązki administratorów danych osobowych
tekst:
Celem tego artykułu jest wyjaśnienie, w jaki sposób Allegro wypełnia swoje obowiązki jako administrator danych osobowych w kontekście RODO. RODO to skrót od General Data Protection Regulation (Rozporządzenie o ochronie danych osobowych), które ma na celu ochronę prywatności i danych osobowych obywateli Unii Europejskiej. W tym kontekście, Allegro, jako platforma handlowa, ma szereg obowiązków wobec swoich użytkowników.
Weryfikacja danych w celu zapewnienia bezpieczeństwa
W przypadku, gdy użytkownik przeprowadza proces weryfikacji danych w celu zapewnienia bezpieczeństwa, Allegro wykonuje weryfikację w celu potwierdzenia tożsamości użytkownika. Jeśli weryfikacja zakończy się pozytywnie, Allegro prześle użytkownikowi kopię jego danych, zachowując przy tym odpowiednie środki bezpieczeństwa.
Prawo do usunięcia danych
Masz prawo zażądać od nas, abyśmy usunęli Twoje dane. Zrobimy to, gdy:
- rozwiążesz z nami umowę
- nie będzie innej podstawy prawnej, która będzie nakładała na nas obowiązek dalszego ich przetwarzania.
Jeśli po Twoim żądaniu usunięcia danych okaże się, że jesteśmy zobowiązani prawnie, aby dalej przetwarzać Twoje dane, poinformujemy Cię o tym.
Dowiedz się więcej
.
Prawo do sprostowania danych
Z tego prawa możesz skorzystać, jeśli zauważysz, że Twoje dane osobowe są nieprawidłowe lub niekompletne. W takim wypadku zobowiązujemy się usunąć ewentualne niezgodności lub błędy danych, które przetwarzamy, oraz uzupełnić je, jeśli będą niekompletne.
Jeśli chcesz zaktualizować swoje dane, zrobisz to w zakładce
Dane konta
.
Dowiedz się więcej
.
Prawo do ograniczenia przetwarzania danych do ich przechowywania
Na Twoją prośbę ograniczymy przetwarzanie Twoich danych tylko do ich przechowywania. Przestaniemy wtedy wykonywać inne czynności składające się na przetwarzanie danych, takie jak ich udostępnianie. Dotyczy to sytuacji, gdy:
- ktoś nieprawnie wykorzystał Twoje dane do rejestracji konta Allegro, a Ty będziesz ich potrzebować, aby wyjaśnić tę sytuację, na przykład z organami ścigania.
Pamiętaj, że ograniczenie przetwarzania danych może wpłynąć na możliwość korzystania z niektórych funkcji platformy Allegro. Jeśli masz jakiekolwiek pytania lub wątpliwości dotyczące swoich praw w kontekście RODO, skontaktuj się z nami poprzez nasze wsparcie użytkowników. Z chęcią pomożemy Ci w zrozumieniu swoich praw i obowiązków.

naglowek: Allegro and Personal Data Protection (RODO): What You Need to Know
tekst:
If you used your data to register an Allegro account, and you'll need them to clarify this situation, for example with law enforcement authorities,

Your data won't be needed for the purposes of processing anymore, but you'll need them to establish, pursue, or defend your claims.
In such a case,
write to us.

The right to data transfer
At your request, within a month, we will send you a file with your data in a structured, commonly used CSV format.
If you want to download your data, you can do it
through the My Allegro tab
or through
our contact form.

If you write to us, for security reasons you will go through verification. If it is successful, we will send you a copy of your data. We will maintain appropriate security measures in the process.
Take care of the security of your data and before you decide to transfer them, make sure who will receive them.
The right to object regarding data profiling
In the Personalization tab,
you can express consent or objection to profiling (basic) and to marketing actions resulting from profiling. You do this using the [include] or [exclude] options.

Thanks to profiling, we can better match search results and ads to your preferences. This way, you'll save time searching for products that interest you, and the ads we show you will be more aligned with your expectations.

After disabling personalization,
log out of your Allegro account on all devices.

tytul: GDPR - jak Allegro spełnia obowiązki administratorów danych osobowych
naglowek: Informacje o przetwarzaniu danych osobowych przez Allegro
tekst:
Allegro jako administrator danych osobowych zobowiązany jest do ich ochrony. Dla zapewnienia tej ochrony wprowadziliśmy szereg rozwiązań, które pomagają w spełnieniu wymogów RODO (Rozporządzenia o ochronie danych osobowych).

Oto jakie kroki podejmujemy:
1. **Przestrzeganie zasad bezpieczeństwa**: Stosujemy najwyższe standardy bezpieczeństwa w przechowywaniu i przetwarzaniu danych osobowych. To między innymi szyfrowanie danych, regularne aktualizacje systemów oraz szkolenia dla naszych pracowników.
2. **Prawa użytkowników**: Zapewniamy użytkownikom możliwość zarządzania swoimi danymi osobowymi. Mogą oni przeglądać, aktualizować lub usunąć swoje dane w ustawieniach konta. Dodatkowo, użytkownicy mogą korzystać z prawa do sprzeciwu, wycofania zgody lub żądania dostępu do swoich danych.
3. **Wyraźna zgoda**: Przed przetwarzaniem danych osobowych prosimy o wyraźną zgodę użytkowników. Ta zgoda jest dokumentowana i przechowywana zgodnie z przepisami RODO.
4. **Przejrzystość informacji**: Informujemy użytkowników o tym, w jaki sposób ich dane osobowe są przetwarzane, w jakim celu oraz przez kogo. Te informacje są dostępne w Polityce Prywatności, którą regularnie aktualizujemy.
5. **Ochrona nieletnich**: Przestrzegamy szczególnych zasad ochrony danych nieletnich. W przypadku osób poniżej 13. roku życia, rodzic lub opiekun prawny musi wyrazić zgodę na przetwarzanie ich danych osobowych.
6. **Współpraca z organami nadzorczymi**: Współpracujemy z organami nadzorczymi w zakresie ochrony danych, takimi jak Urząd Ochrony Danych Osobowych (UODO), jeśli tylko będzie to konieczne.

Jako użytkownik Allegro masz prawo:
- do dostępu do swoich danych osobowych,
- do ich poprawienia lub usunięcia,
- do wycofania zgody na przetwarzanie danych,
- do wniesienia sprzeciwu wobec przetwarzania danych,
- do otrzymania kopii swoich danych w standardowym formacie.

Aby skorzystać z tych praw, skontaktuj się z nami poprzez formularz kontaktowy lub wysyłając wiadomość na adres .

Dodatkowo, w celu zrealizowania swojego prawa do sprzeciwu wobec marketingu bezpośredniego:
- Wyłącz personalizację reklam w ustawieniach konta Allegro.
- W zakładce Zgody na powiadomienia odznacz zgody na otrzymywanie informacji marketingowych.
- W zakładce Personalizacja wybierz opcję Wyłącz.

Po wyłączeniu personalizacji zaloguj się ponownie z każdego urządzenia i usuń pliki cookies – szczegółowe instrukcje znajdziesz w naszej Polityce Prywatności. Proces ten może potrwać do 48 godzin.

Pamiętaj, że możesz w każdej chwili zmienić swoje ustawienia dotyczące danych osobowych w zakładce Ustawienia konta. Zachęcamy do aktywnego zarządzania swoimi danymi i świadomego korzystania z oferowanych przez nas rozwiązań.

tytul: GDPR - what are the buyer's rights resulting from the regulation on the protection of personal data?
tekst:
Sellers - if they are subject to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), i.e., the regulation on the protection of personal data, and they obtain your personal data from us, they are obliged to fulfill all the obligations arising from the GDPR and other legal provisions towards you.
Therefore, as a buyer, you are entitled to:

* the right of access to your personal data
* the right to rectification and the right to deletion of your personal data
* the right to limit the processing of your personal data
* the right to transfer your personal data
* the right not to be subject to automated decision-making, including profiling
* the right to object to the processing of your personal data.

Each seller on Allegro can inform their clients about how they process their data. They can add to their account their own
seller's privacy policy
. This is not mandatory and we do not review the content of such documents.
If a seller provides their own privacy policy, you will find it in the section
About the seller
when you select an offer. We will also send it to you by email along with the purchase confirmation.

tytul: RODO - When and How to Remove Your Personal Data from Allegro
naglowek: Removing Personal Data from Allegro: What You Need to Know
tekst:
We will delete your personal data once you terminate your activity on Allegro. Therefore, to delete your data, first
resolve your agreement
. If you don't have access to your account –
write to us
, and we will resolve the agreement for you.
The right to have your data deleted is not an absolute right, and we may refuse to delete your personal data. This happens when there are circumstances that allow us to process your personal data after the termination of the agreement.
If you have made purchases on Allegro from your account, your personal data will be processed for 3 years from the end of the year in which you terminate the agreement. The legal basis is Allegro's legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR) in defending its rights.
If you have sold items or used a coupon from your account, this period extends to 6 years from the end of the year in which you terminate the agreement. In this case, the data processing is necessary to fulfill our legal obligations (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR) arising from tax and accounting regulations.
After the termination of the agreement, we will process your data
only for the purposes listed below
, based on Allegro's legitimate interest, which is:
dispute resolution and defense against disputes, including debt collection, court, arbitration, and mediation proceedings
conducting statistical analyses
ensuring accountability (invoicing)

tytul: GDPR - kiedy i jak usunąć swoje dane osobowe z Allegro

tekst:

* windykacji należności
* prowadzenia postępowań sądowych, arbitrażowych i mediacyjnych
* prowadzenia analiz statystycznych
* zapewnienia rozliczalności (wykazania spełnienia przez nas obowiązków wynikających z przepisów prawa).

Gdy wygasają te cele przetwarzania danych, Twoje dane automatycznie usuwamy z Allegro.

tekst: Rozporządzenie obowiązuje od 25 maja 2018 w całej Unii Europejskiej. Zastąpiło ono ustawę z 29 sierpnia 1997 o ochronie danych osobowych.

tytul: RODO – podstawowe informacje
naglowek: Kto podlega, a kto nie podlega RODO
tekst:
Kto podlega, a kto nie podlega RODO
RODO dotyczy każdej firmy świadczącej usługi dla osób fizycznych w Unii Europejskiej. RODO obejmuje również firmy, które nie mają siedziby w krajach UE, ale oferują swoje usługi osobom tam mieszkającym. Oznacza to, że przepisy RODO muszą być wdrożone zarówno przez Allegro, jak i przez każdego przedsiębiorcę sprzedającego na naszym serwisie.
RODO nie ma zastosowania do działalności osobistej lub domowej. Oznacza to, że osoba fizyczna prowadząca działalność gospodarczą musi stosować RODO do danych osobowych swoich klientów i pracowników, ale nie stosuje RODO do danych, które przetwarza w celach czysto prywatnych, na przykład: do danych adresatów, którym wysyła corocznie kartki świąteczne.

tytul: RODO - podstawowe informacje
naglowek: Co to są dane osobowe
tekst:
Co to są dane osobowe
Są to informacje odnoszące się do konkretnej osoby fizycznej, które mogą pomóc pośrednio lub bezpośrednio w identyfikacji tej osoby, na przykład: imię i nazwisko, numer telefonu, adres zamieszkania, adres e-mail. Do danych osobowych zaliczamy też na przykład: informacje o zakupach lub sprzedaży danej osoby, o jej pochodzeniu rasowym, stanie zdrowia czy orientacji seksualnej.

tytul: GDPR - podstawowe informacje
naglowek: Jakie są warunki przetwarzania danych osobowych
tekst:
Jakie są warunki przetwarzania danych osobowych
Warunkiem przetwarzania danych osobowych jest podstawa prawna. Najczęstsze podstawy prawne:
zgoda osoby, której dane dotyczą
przetwarzanie danych jest niezbędne do wykonania umowy z osobą, której dane dotyczą
przetwarzanie jest niezbędne do wypełnienia obowiązku prawnego ciążącego na administratorze
przetwarzanie jest niezbędne do celów wynikających z prawnie uzasadnionych interesów realizowanych przez administratora lub przez stronę trzecią, na przykład: operatora płatności, przewoźnika, itp.

tytul: GDPR - Basic Information
naglowek: What is the principle of data minimisation
tekst:
What is the principle of data minimisation
According to this principle, you can process only personal data that are necessary to achieve the purpose of the data processing, for example: if the purpose is to process a customer's order, the seller should not collect data about the customer's family situation.

tytul: RODO – podstawowe informacje
naglowek: Czym jest profilowanie
tekst:
Czym jest profilowanie
Profilowanie to automatyczne przetwarzanie danych, które ma na celu ocenę danej osoby i przewidzenie jej zachowania. Rozróżniamy 2 typy profilowania:
Profilowanie
zwykłe
– na przykład: do celów marketingu bezpośredniego, czyli dobór reklamy na stronie internetowej w oparciu o wcześniejszą aktywność. W tym przypadku, każda osoba będzie miała prawo wnieść sprzeciw, by nie podlegać profilowaniu.
Profilowanie
na potrzeby automatycznie podejmowanych decyzji
– na przykład: automatyczne obliczenie składki ubezpieczeniowej, wartości kredytu w oparciu o dane podane na stronie internetowej. W tym przypadku system informatyczny przetwarza dane dokonując skomplikowanej oceny różnych czynników również z wykorzystaniem danych nie odnoszących się bezpośrednio do danej osoby (dane statystyczne).

tytul: GDPR – basic information
naglowek: What is the right to be forgotten
tekst:
What is the right to be forgotten
It is a popular name for the right to delete data in the event of the goal and legal basis for data processing expiring.

tytul: GDPR - podstawowe informacje
naglowek: Czym jest prawo do przenoszenia danych osobowych
tekst:
Czym jest prawo do przenoszenia danych osobowych
Każda osoba, która ma konto na Allegro, ma prawo do otrzymania przetwarzanych o sobie danych w ustrukturyzowanym, powszechnie używanym formacie. Zapewniamy bezpieczne pobranie lub przesłanie danych innemu administratorowi.

tytul: Allegro Pay Business – What It Is, How It Works, and When You Should Use It
naglowek: What Is Allegro Pay Business
tekst:
What Is Allegro Pay Business
Allegro Pay Business is a payment method available to buyers on
Allegro Business
. With it, you can:
make payments for business purchases within 30 or 60 days after the purchase
spread the payment over 6, 12, 18, or 24 installments - provided that this is an order from one seller with a value of at least 500 PLN.
The minimum order amount with Allegro Pay Business is 50 PLN - this applies to a purchase from one seller.

tytul: Allegro Pay Business – what it is, how it works, and when you should use it
naglowek: How Allegro Pay Business Works
tekst:
How Allegro Pay Business Works
The Allegro Pay Business payment method is based on a purchase limit for businesses. This means that you can use a renewable purchase limit - up to PLN 50,000. Your limit is set based on information about your company from publicly available external databases. If your company has already made purchases on Allegro, we will also take your purchase history into account.
The provider of the Allegro Pay Business service is PragmaGO.
To use this payment method, simply choose Allegro Pay Business when making a purchase - the seller will receive the money immediately, and you will receive a purchase invoice. If you do not pay it within the specified term, we will split your payment into 6 installments.

Następnie zapoznaj się z regulaminami Allegro i PragmaGO i zaakceptuj je. Prosimy o to, aby móc przekazać Twoje dane rejestrowe i handlowe z Allegro firmie PragmaGO, która podjejmie decyzję o włączeniu Ci usługi Allegro Pay Business.

Jeśli decyzja będzie pozytywna,
potwierdź włączenie usługi kodem SMS

Gotowe! Od teraz możesz kupować z Allegro Pay Business.

We perform the next calculations in real time and automatically. As a financing entity, we are obliged to assess the creditworthiness before a client enters into a credit obligation. We may propose to increase your funds if we positively assess your shopping history on Allegro and your credit history. If your financial situation changes, we may also decrease it.

Before submitting a request, familiarize yourself with the information on service rejection, and then click [confirm].

To submit a request to cancel Allegro Pay, use our contact page. Go to the [contact page] and in the message window, state that you wish to cancel the Allegro Pay service. Regardless of the communication method you choose, we will contact you to confirm your identity. We will process your request as quickly as possible – within 4 working days at the most.

Simply send a cancellation request to our address:

ul. Wierzbięcice 1B
61-569 Poznań

Using Allegro Pay
Allegro Pay allows you to split your payments into installments and pay lower monthly rates. You can choose from 3 to 30 monthly installments.
To use Allegro Pay, you must meet several conditions:
- You will repay the loan for any purchase (if the payment is spread over monthly installments, it's enough to repay one of them)
- You have at least 100 zł remaining to repay
- The order has not been canceled or returned (if you return or cancel only a part of it, the amount to repay for the remaining purchases must be at least 200 zł)
- You have no credit repayment delays
- You have no limit block on Allegro Pay.

Shopping with Allegro Pay
Click on the selected question to see the answer.

At the beginning of your use of Allegro Pay, we may block the service - when you make several purchases, but you haven't made any payments for them yet.
To unblock Allegro Pay, make the first payment for any purchase. If your payment is spread over several monthly installments, you only need to pay one of them - the details are in the Allegro Pay panel.
Once you settle the first installment, the service will be active again. From this moment on, you can use Allegro Pay without any limitations - up to the amount of your funds.

Unfortunately, no. Payment through Allegro Pay is only available if your funds cover the cost of the purchases along with the potential delivery cost.

When you shop with Allegro Pay, you can use Smart! Monets, coupons, and gift cards, but you cannot combine Allegro Pay with other payment methods such as bank transfer or BLIK.
A coupon and gift card reduce the payment amount. On your Allegro Pay credit agreement, you'll find the purchase amount with the discount applied.
The minimum order value still applies for the chosen payment option. The amount to pay, after the discount, which enables using Allegro Pay is:
1 PLN - for delayed payment over 30 days
200 PLN - for payment in 2 to 20 monthly installments
1,000 PLN - for payment in 30 monthly installments.
If you only use the cashback option, the minimum payment amount still applies.

Allegro Pay Payment

You can always find the current payment schedule in your
Allegro Pay panel.
If you have several purchases with Allegro Pay and they have not been paid yet, you will see a separate schedule for each of them.
If you pay more than the required amount of the installment or return part of the purchased items - we will automatically recalculate and update your schedule.
Select [check details] to:
check the history of your Allegro Pay purchases
verify the amount remaining to be paid in full
find the account number to which you can make a payment on your own.

If you have already signed credit agreements with the option to pay within 30 days or in 0% installments, you can extend the payment term for a single agreement or combine selected agreements and pay lower installments. You have a choice of 3 to 30 monthly installments.
To do this, you must meet several conditions:
you pay off the credit for any purchase (if the payment is spread over monthly installments, it is sufficient to pay one of them)
there is not less than 100 PLN remaining to be paid
the order has not been canceled or returned (if you return or cancel only part of it, the amount to be paid for the remaining purchases must be at least 100 PLN)
you do not have any payment delays for the credit
you do not have a block on the Allegro Pay limit.

Allegro Pay Payments

We will remind you of the approaching payment date and the required amount. If you are late with a payment, we will consider the unpaid amount as overdue. Until you settle the overdue amount, we may limit your further use of Allegro Pay. From the required amount, we may also charge penalty interest - these should be paid first. Currently, the maximum penalty interest rate for late payment is 18.5% per annum.

Yes, you can always pay part or all of your purchase in advance.
If the payment is due within the next 30 days, you can conveniently make it through the
Allegro Pay panel
. Larger payments can be made by logging into your bank.

Yes, you can always pay part or all of your Allegro Pay credit agreement in advance.
If you choose to pay within 30 days, you can pay your purchase directly from the Allegro Pay panel at any time. You can also pay off the entire credit agreement in advance if you have spread the payment over several monthly installments.
Learn more about how to pay for your purchases with Allegro Pay.

The automatic payment with Allegro Pay credit card option is not available.

We will block your funds if you use the initial purchase pool from Allegro Pay and do not make any payment. The block is one-time. If your payment is spread over several monthly installments, the payment terms will apply.

tekst:
Spłata Allegro Pay
Płatności dokonywane w ramach Allegro Pay są jednorazowe. Jeśli nie dokonasz żadnej spłaty, usługa zostanie zablokowana. Blokada jest jednorazowa. Jeśli Twoja płatność jest rozłożona na kilka miesięcznych rat, wystarczy, że opłacisz jedną z nich – szczegóły znajdziesz w
panelu Allegro Pay
. Po tym, jak uregulujesz pierwszą ratę, usługa będzie ponownie aktywna. Od tego momentu możesz już korzystać z Allegro Pay do wysokości dostępnych środków – już bez ograniczeń.
Jeśli nie będziesz regulować swoich spłat, dalsze korzystanie z usługi może zostać zablokowane. Przed każdą datą spłaty przypomnimy Ci o zbliżającym się terminie i wymaganej kwocie. Jeśli jednak spóźnisz się ze spłatą, a środki zostaną zablokowane – w pierwszej kolejności opłać wymaganą kwotę. Znajdziesz ją w Twoim
panelu Allegro Pay
. Środki odblokujemy od razu po otrzymaniu wpłaty.
Jeżeli poprosimy Cię o uzupełnienie brakujących danych, ale tego nie zrobisz, możemy zablokować Ci usługę i nie skorzystasz z Allegro Pay. Usługę odblokujemy dopiero wtedy, gdy zaktualizujesz dane.

Jeśli potrzebujesz zaświadczenie o spłacie umów, przejdź do

tytul: Allegro Pay - Return or Cancellation of a Purchase Item
naglowek: Return or Cancellation of a Purchase Item with Allegro Pay
tekst:
Returns and complaints for purchases made with Allegro Pay are subject to the
rules
that apply on Allegro. If you decide to return or cancel a purchase paid with Allegro Pay, the money we receive from the seller will be credited to your outstanding payments.
The seller should return the money to you within 14 days from the moment they receive your completed return form. However, they may wait until they receive the returned item.
For purchases made with Allegro Pay, we will wait for the seller's refund until:
30 days for payments made within 30 days
1 month for other installment options
As soon as we receive the money, we will process and close your agreement, and in the case of a partial refund, we will process it partially.

You are responsible for paying for your purchase yourself. To enable this, we will extend your payment deadline in your
payment schedule
. You will not incur any additional costs due to this. You can find the updated schedule in your
Allegro Pay panel
.

If the seller does not return the money
If you send back the product and the seller does not return the money –
start a Discussion
. If the Discussion does not resolve the issue, you can use
Allegro Buyer Protection
to recover the money.

Starting a Discussion does not exempt you from the obligation to pay for the products purchased with Allegro Pay by the deadline.

tytul: Allegro Pay – Refund or Cancelment of a Purchase
naglowek: Refund or Cancelment of a Purchase Made with Allegro Pay
tekst:
refund or cancelment of a purchase made with Allegro Pay.

The Initiation of a Discussion does not exempt you from the obligation to pay for products purchased from Allegro Pay by the designated deadline.

If the Seller refunds the money after you have already paid for the purchase
When:
the Seller refunds the money to Allegro Pay after you have already paid for the purchases
and the amount you paid yourself is higher than the installment amount
we will first use the overpayment to cover any outstanding payments from your other Allegro Pay agreements. We will start with the oldest payment.
If you do not have any outstanding payments, we will refund the overpaid money using the same payment method you used to pay for the order. If a refund is not possible, we will return the money to the
account you provided in the Allegro Pay service application form
or to another account you specified in the Allegro Pay panel for refunding overpayment.
This account must be held in a Polish bank.

Information about the refund can be found in the
Allegro Pay panel
.

If you ask the Seller, you can receive a refund to an Allegro Pay gift card that you used for the purchase in stationary or online stores outside of Allegro.

Refund or Cancelment of a Purchase Made with a Gift Card
When you receive a refund from the Seller, we will first apply it to your Allegro Pay agreement. If the value of the refund is higher than the value of the agreement, you will receive the remaining amount in the form of a new gift card.

tytul: Allegro Pay - Refund or Cancellation of a Purchase
tekst:
If you return or cancel the purchase of an item, we will process the refund on your Allegro Pay agreement. If the value of the refund is higher than the value of the agreement, you will receive the remaining amount as a new gift card or voucher. You can use these on the same terms as the original card or voucher.
Will the refund reduce my used purchase budget?
The refund amount from the seller does not reduce the used
purchase budget. If you want to buy a product that exceeds your budget, change the limit amount in the Allegro Pay panel. You don't need to remember it - when you exceed the budget, we will let you know.

tytul: What Do Payment Statuses Mean?
naglowek: Understanding Different Payment Statuses
tekst:
What Do Payment Statuses Mean?
Your payment may have a status: started, canceled, completed, or failed.
Started
– this is the initial status of any payment. If you're paying by card, BLIK, or a quick payment, it changes after a few minutes. If it doesn't, despite the payment, check if we've taken the money from your account. If not, you can cancel the payment and then retry it in the
My Purchases tab.
If the payment was taken, but the status doesn't change,
write to us.
Other reasons why a payment may have a status of
started
:
if in the delivery and payment options form you choose a traditional bank transfer and entrust the payment to another institution (for example, the Polish Post Office), the processing time of the transfer depends on that institution. Such a payment is processed up to 3 days – don't retry it earlier. In this way, you cancel the payment and the money will return to the account of the institution that made the transfer. If this happened and the institution doesn't have your payment,
write to us.
if you choose another method to finalize the payment, your payment will have a status of started for 10 days. After that time, due to the lack of payment through Allegro, we automatically cancel it.

tytul: What do the payment statuses mean?
naglowek: What do the different payment statuses mean?
tekst:
What do the different payment statuses mean?
When a payment is taken from your bank account, your payment will be returned to the account from which it was made. If the payment has not been taken (or is only blocked), you do not need to do anything - the bank will release it automatically according to its internal procedures. If you still want to speed up the purchase, you can click [Re-pay] in the My Purchases tab.

Completed
- the payment has been processed, and we have transferred it to the seller.
Failed
- the bank has rejected your payment. You can try again in the Purchased tab.

tytul: What Do the Payment Statuses Mean?
naglowek: Understanding Different Payment Statuses for Instalment Payments
tekst:
Understanding Different Payment Statuses for Instalment Payments
Your instalment payment can have a status of: started, cancelled or completed.
Started
– The lending partner is reviewing your loan application. This process can take up to 120 hours. You haven't purchased any products yet.
Cancelled
– The loan agreement was not concluded (the loan was not approved or not activated for you). You haven't purchased any products yet.
Completed
– The loan was approved for you. You were able to purchase products, and your payment was transferred to the seller.

tytul: What do the statuses of your payments mean?
naglowek: What if your payment is not completed and you want to pay again?
tekst:
What if your payment is not completed and you want to pay again
Go to the section
My purchases
and find the relevant order. We will allow you to make a payment again with the following payment statuses:
started
– if you suspect that the payment will not be completed correctly, click [cancel payment]. This button will appear 5 minutes after the payment has started. Then, choose the delivery option again and select a payment method.
cancelled
or
failed
– click [retry payment] and choose the delivery option and payment method again.
If the seller has returned your payment, you will not be able to pay again from the section
My purchases
.

tytul: What Do Payment Statuses Mean?
naglowek: When Can a Seller Ask You to Top Up Your Payment
tekst:
When Can a Seller Ask You to Top Up Your Payment
A seller can ask you to top up your payment if your deposit doesn't match the transaction costs (for example, if you forget to pay for shipping). They will do this via email – to the address you entered in your account settings.
In the email, you will find the amount needed to top up, the transaction details, and a link to the top-up form. The seller can also include explanations in this message. If they don't, and you're not sure why you need to top up,
contact the seller.
You can top up through:
The top-up form, which you'll receive via email
The 'My Purchases' tab – for a given order, you can top up only once.
To top up through the 'My Purchases' tab:
Next to the relevant order, click [order details].
Click [expand order details]. Below the payment amount, you'll find the option 'Top Up' – click on it.
Enter the top-up amount, choose your payment method, and click [pay]. Through the 'My Purchases' tab, you can top up up to a maximum of 30 PLN.
You have 60 days from the purchase to make the top-up.

tekst:
What do payment numbers mean?
Each payment for a purchase on Allegro has a unique number. This helps you easily find information about a specific payment.
If you have questions about your payment, provide this number when contacting the seller or us. You can also provide
order number.
You can find the payment number:
in the email notification about your payment for the purchased product
in the details of each order in the My Purchases section,
in the Payment part.

tytul: What to do to get a receipt for your purchases
naglowek: To get a receipt for your purchases, you can mark the 'I want to receive a receipt' option when you're making your purchase on Allegro. Make sure to enter your correct invoice details before paying. You can also access your invoices via the KSeF system.
tekst:
What is the National e-Invoice System (KSeF)
The KSeF is a solution by the Ministry of Finance, allowing businesses to issue, receive, and store structured invoices. Issuing invoices in KSeF is mandatory for all Polish VAT taxpayers:
from 1 February 2026 for large businesses – those with sales over 200 million PLN (with VAT) in 2024
from 1 April 2026 (with certain exceptions) for all other businesses.
All buyer businesses can receive their invoices from these companies in KSeF.
What to do to get a receipt for your purchases
Simply check the 'I want to receive a receipt' option during your purchase on Allegro. Before you pay, make sure you provide accurate invoice details. If you want to change them, click [change details]. You can then enter new details – either your own (for consumer purchases) or those of your business (for non-consumer purchases).

Where to find your invoice
You can find your invoice for a purchase in two places on Allegro, depending on where the seller includes it – and on your KSeF account.
1. Message Center
You can download your invoice from
Message Center
. The seller adds the invoice as an attachment in the message. Click on it and save the document to your device.
When you receive a message from the seller, you'll see

2. Purchase Details

This method of downloading an invoice is not available in the mobile app.

The seller can attach an invoice in the
Purchase Details
section.
Go to the
My Purchases
section.
Find your order and click [Purchase Details].
Then click [Expand purchase details].
Under the purchase amount, you'll find the
Invoice icon
– click on it.
We'll display a window with invoice details and a download button. To save the document on your device, click [Download].
3. Your Account in KSeF
If the seller issues an invoice for your company in the National e-Invoice System (KSeF), you can find it there. The invoice will be stored in KSeF for 10 years. Learn how to step-by-step retrieve an invoice in KSeF.

tytul: Is Allegro Pay a member of industry organizations?
naglowek: Allegro Pay's Membership in Industry Organizations
tekst:
As Allegro Pay Sp. z o. o., we actively participate in initiatives aimed at developing the fintech industry. We are a member of the following initiatives:
* Forum Technologii Bankowych at Związek Banków Polskich
* Fundacja na rzecz innowacji finansowych Fintech Polska
* Związek Przedsiębiorstw Finansowych w Polsce.
Membership in the Związek Przedsiębiorstw Finansowych obligates us to adhere to:
* Principles of Good Practice
* Good Practice Guidelines for the Distribution of Services by Loan Institutions
.
This institution verifies whether we meet these obligations. Anyone can report a violation. Complaints are accepted by the Ethics Ombudsman and the Office of the Związek Przedsiębiorstw Finansowych.
The Principles of Good Practice are based on general ethical standards and are in line with the law. They have been adopted by all companies operating in the financial market, including those involved in consumer finance, and which are members of the Związek Przedsiębiorstw Finansowych in Poland.
The Good Practice Guidelines for the Distribution of Services by Loan Institutions aim to protect the interests of consumers and increase transparency in the financial market.

tytul: Is Using Allegro Pay Safe?
naglowek: Ensuring Your Safety with Allegro Pay
tekst:
Yes, your complete safety is ensured because your personal data is protected by Allegro sp. z o.o. and Allegro Pay sp. z o.o. - both registered with the Financial Supervision Commission (KNF).

Check:
Allegro's Privacy Policy
Allegro Pay's Privacy Policy
.

We provide financing as Allegro Pay sp. z o.o. To grant you funds, we only require basic information about you.
You don't need to worry about providing too many personal details. We use high-grade security measures to keep all your personal data confidential and intact. The application to activate Allegro Pay is only available when you log in to your Allegro account through a secure SSL connection. You can check the security certificate in your browser window.
During the activation of Allegro Pay, we may ask you for additional verification of your data by logging into your bank account. This helps us verify your identity and account history. For this purpose, we use the secure Kontomatik application, which is also used by banks and other financial institutions. The Kontomatik application complies with the European Union's requirements regarding the protection of personal data and the provision of payment services. Kontomatik UAB is a licensed entity that provides access to account services under the PSD2 directive.
Learn more about the Kontomatik application
.
An additional safety feature is the SMS code used for activation

tytul: Is Using Allegro Pay Safe?
naglowek: Safety of Allegro Pay
tekst:
Allegro Pay is a safe way to make payments on Allegro. To access your account, we use a secure authentication method based on the PSD2 directive.
Learn more about the Kontomatik app

tytul: What is Allegro Cash?
tekst:
Allegro Cash was a service available on our platform until June 30, 2025. We offered it in collaboration with our partner – Aion Bank S.A. As part of Allegro Cash, our partner managed a bank account for you, which was linked to your Allegro account. When your purchases on Allegro were paid from this account, a part of the amount spent returned to you in the form of cashback.

The Allegro Cash service is no longer available. All accounts were closed on July 1, 2025.

If you have questions or concerns about your Allegro Cash account – contact Aion Bank's customer service directly. You can do this:
by phone: +48 22 523 46 54
via email: info@aion.be
in person at a branch: Aion Bank SA Customer Service Office in Poland, ul. Dobra 40, 00-344 Warsaw.

how Allegro Cash operated
previous terms and other documents.

tytul: What is a transfer of claims from an Allegro Pay agreement?
naglowek: Understanding the Transfer of Claims from an Allegro Pay Agreement
tekst:
We provide financing as Allegro Pay sp. z o.o., but we collaborate with other financial entities, such as banks. Currently, our partner is UniCredit S.A. This means that financing for some of your purchases may be provided by UniCredit S.A. - this is known as the transfer of claims from an Allegro Pay agreement to UniCredit S.A. This means that our partner, in accordance with GDPR regulations, becomes the administrator of your personal data.

The transfer of claims does not affect how you use Allegro Pay or the terms of your agreement. The amount, terms, and method of repayment, as well as the associated costs, remain unchanged.

Frequently Asked Questions
Click on the question you have selected to see the answer.

As the administrator, UniCredit S.A. will process your personal data solely for the purpose of servicing your Allegro Pay agreement. Among other things, they will report the repayment history of your agreement to the credit database of the Credit Information Bureau (BIK). In this way, every timely repayment will contribute to your positive credit history.
If you use the BIK Alerts option, you may receive a notification about the registration in BIK of an obligation towards UniCredit S.A. In the case of the transfer of claims from several agreements, you may receive notifications for each of them. After the complete repayment of all obligations, your data will be removed from the BIK database.

For all matters related to your Allegro Pay agreement - including issues related to arrears, complaints, and changes to the agreement - continue to contact us.

naglowek: Understanding Leasing - Step by Step Guide
tekst:
In this guide, we will walk you through the entire leasing process, from applying for a lease to making a down payment and receiving your leased item.

**Step 1: Choose the right lease**

First, select the lease that suits your needs best. At Allegro, we offer several leasing options, including long-term leases and short-term leases. Consider your budget, the value of the item, and the duration of the lease to make the right choice.

**Step 2: Complete the lease application**

Once you've chosen your lease, you'll need to complete an application. This will involve providing information about your financial situation, including your income, credit history, and employment status. You'll also need to provide identification and proof of ownership or representation for the company you're applying on behalf of.

**Step 3: Review and sign the lease agreement**

After submitting your application, our partner will review it and make a decision. If approved, you'll receive a notification via SMS and email with a link to the lease agreement. You'll need to review the agreement, accept the terms, and sign it electronically. If you choose an operational lease, you'll need to provide a copy of your identification document to the partner for verification.

**Step 4: Pay the down payment**

Once you've signed the lease agreement, you'll need to make a down payment. This is typically a percentage of the total lease amount and is used to secure your lease. You can pay this amount using a business bank account.

**Step 5: Receive your leased item**

After completing the application, signing the agreement, and making the down payment, your leased item will be shipped to you. This typically happens within a few days of completing these steps.

**Step 6: Check the decision and pay the initial fee**

After submitting your application, our partner will review it and make a decision. If approved, you'll receive a notification via SMS and email with a link to the lease agreement. You'll need to review the agreement, accept the terms, and sign it electronically. If you choose an operational lease, you'll need to provide a copy of your identification document to the partner for verification. Additionally, you'll need to pay the initial fee, which is typically a percentage of the total lease amount. This can be paid using a business bank account.

**Frequently Asked Questions**

Q: Can a single owner of a business apply for leasing?
A: Yes, a single owner of a business can apply for leasing. However, if you're part of a partnership or company, you'll need to designate a representative who has the authority to apply on behalf of the business. This representative must be registered in the National Court Register (KRS) in Poland.

Q: How do I know who can apply for leasing on behalf of a business?
A: When you enter the business data on our partner's website, the system will indicate who can apply for leasing on behalf of the business. This typically includes the owner or a designated representative with the appropriate authority.

Q: What if I need help with the leasing application process?
A: If you need assistance with the leasing application process, you can use the chat feature on our partner's website. The chat icon is usually located at the bottom of the page. You can also contact us directly by clicking [contact us] at the bottom of this article. Our support team will be happy to assist you with any questions or concerns you may have.

tytul: What is the CVV2/CVC2 code?
tekst:
The CVV2/CVC2 code (Card Verification Value 2 / Card Verification Code 2) protects your card payments online. It's a sequence of a few digits, unique to each payment card. You provide it when you pay by card without physically using it, for example, online.
What is it used for
The CVV2/CVC2 code is a widely used, global standard. Verifying it provides additional security for remote payments and limits the possibility that someone else will use your card online. If you see this code on your payment card, it means you can use it to pay online.
Where to find the CVV2/CVC2 code
The CVV2/CVC2 code is
three or four digits, which you'll find on the back of your payment card
. Most commonly, you'll see it next to the strip with your signature.
The CVV2/CVC2 code is placed only:
on your card
in a secure system at your bank's issuer.
It's not printed anywhere else or placed in any other locations. This makes it very difficult to steal. Scammers cannot pay online with your card without knowing this code - even if they know its number, expiration date, or your name and surname.

If you have more than one trusted device and one is stolen or lost, immediately remove it from the list of trusted devices – use another device that you have access to.
If you only have one trusted device and it is stolen or lost, contact us. We can remove it from the list of trusted devices associated with your account.

To do this:
Open the Trusted Devices tab in the Allegro Click service panel.
Select the device for which you want to change the PIN code.
Click [Change PIN].
Enter the new 4-digit PIN code you want to set for the selected trusted device.
Repeat the new PIN code

tytul: How to Add a Trusted Device in Allegro Click Service
tekst:
To add a trusted device in the Allegro Click service, follow these steps:
1. Go to the 'Trusted Devices' section in your Allegro Click account.
2. Choose the device you want to add.
3. You will be prompted to enter a new 4-digit PIN for this device.
4. Enter the new PIN and confirm it by entering it again.
5. You will be asked to confirm the change by entering the current PIN that is valid for the device where you are making the change.

What to do if you forget your PIN
If you forget the PIN for your trusted device, you can use a security key to reset your PIN.
To reset your PIN:
- When you forget it during payment authorization with Allegro Click, use the 'I forgot my PIN' option.
- We will then ask you to enter a 24-character security key.
- Directly in the 'Trusted Devices' section in your Allegro Click panel, you can do this just like when changing your PIN.

To enter the correct Allegro PIN, you have 3 attempts. After the third unsuccessful attempt, we will block your device. You can only unblock it using the security key. If you enter the wrong security key 3 times, your trusted device will be completely blocked.

What to do if you forget your security key
If you forget the security key for your trusted device, you cannot reset your PIN. If you want to continue using the device in the future, you will need to delete your trusted device.
To delete a trusted device if you do not remember your security key:
- Contact our customer service team for assistance.

tytul: How to Update Your Data in Allegro Pay
naglowek: Updating Your Data in Allegro Pay
tekst:
You can update some of your data yourself in the Allegro Pay panel. The data must match the information on your current identity document. We will verify it against external databases, so any discrepancies may delay or prevent the update of your data.
What data can you update yourself
In the Allegro Pay panel, you can update:
- your last name
- your ID number and expiration date
- your country of birth.

If you want to change other data, such as your phone number, 
please contact us.

How to update your data in the Allegro Pay panel
In the section labeled “Options”, select “My Data”.
Click “change” next to the data you want to update.
Fill in all required fields with the information from your current, physical identity document.
Confirm the changes.
After you save the changes, we will automatically check their correctness against external databases. If they do not match your current identity document, we will reject the changes.

To activate and use Allegro Pay, you must provide us with your current data:
- your full name
- your PESEL (Polish personal identification number)
- the series and number of your ID along with the expiration date
- your country of birth
- your phone number.
In the case of a change, such as a name change after marriage, you can update your data only after you receive a new identity document.

tytul: How to Pay for Purchases by Card
tekst:
You can pay for your purchases on Allegro by card. There are three ways to do this, depending on whether you have a saved payment card (or several cards) in your account settings.

How to Pay by Card When You Don't Have a Saved Payment Card
1. In the delivery and payment form, select payment by card.
2. Enter the card details: number, expiration date, and CVV2/CVC2 – these are three or four digits found on the back of your card.
3. If you want to use the card just once, choose [use only once].
4. If you want to use the card and save it for future purchases, choose [use and save for future use].
5. Click [I'm buying and paying].

During card payments, your bank may ask you for additional verification as part of the 3D Secure standard. You will then see a request for an SMS code or payment confirmation in your bank's mobile app.

How to Pay by Card When You Have a Saved Payment Card
1. In the delivery and payment form, click the payment by card option.
2. Click [I'm buying and paying].
3. If you want to add another card, click [options]. You can read about adding a new card here.

How to Pay by Card When You Have Saved Several Payment Cards
1. In the delivery and payment form, select payment by card.
2. If you want to use one of your saved cards, choose it.

What is CVV2/CVC2
CVV2/CVC2 (Card Verification Value 2 / Card Verification Code 2) is a security feature for online card payments. It's a sequence of several digits unique to each payment card. You enter it when making a card payment without physically using the card, such as online.
Verification of CVV2/CVC2 adds an extra layer of security to remote payments and limits the possibility that someone else might use your card online.

three or four digits on the back of your card
. Most commonly, it's located near the strip where you sign your card.
