tytul: How to Pay for Items Bought on Allegro
naglowek: Paying for Items Purchased on Allegro
tekst:
To pay for an item you've purchased on Allegro in one payment, follow these steps:
1. Go to your account and check the My Purchases tab.
2. Look for the items you haven't paid for yet. They should be marked as unpaid.
3. If you won an auction or bought something with the 'Buy Now' option, you'll see the item in the My Purchases tab. We'll show you a 'Not Paid' status until you complete the payment.
4. When buying with the 'Buy Now' option, you'll be prompted to pay during checkout. Click [Buy and Pay] and you'll be redirected to a payment page.
5. Once you confirm the payment, the item in your My Purchases tab will be marked as paid.
6. If you want to pay for multiple items with one payment, don't finalize the payment for the 'Buy Now' items yet. Instead, follow these steps:
7. Select the item you want to purchase and click [Buy Now].
8. Provide your address and choose a shipping method.
9. Select a payment method: bank transfer, credit/debit card, or BLIK.
10. If you choose installments or Allegro Pay, these payments won't be combined with the payment for auction items.
11. Click [Buy and Pay].
12. We'll redirect you to a payment page where you can confirm the payment. Close the page once you've completed the payment. This way, all payments for the items you've purchased will be consolidated into one payment.

To pay for an item purchased on Allegro, follow these steps:

1. **Confirm Your Purchase**: If you're buying from an auction, click [I'm buying and paying]. This will take you to a page where you can confirm your payment. Make sure not to close this page, or you won't pay for the item.

2. **Check the Payment Status**: In the [My Purchases] tab, you'll see a message indicating that your payment is being processed. This may take up to 5 minutes after the purchase. Once your payment reaches the seller, we'll send you an email.

3. **Verify Payment Status**: After a few minutes, you can check the status of your payment. If the item hasn't been paid for, you'll see an option to [Cancel Payment]. Click on this to cancel the payment.

4. **Pay for Multiple Items at Once**: If you want to pay for multiple items bought through an auction or [Buy Now] option, select the items in the [My Purchases] tab and click [Repeat Payment]. Then choose your payment method and complete the transaction.

5. **Make a Top-Up Payment (if needed)**: If you need to make a top-up payment (for example, if shipping costs were not included initially), you can do so in the [My Purchases] tab. Select the relevant order, click [Purchase Details], and choose [Make a Top-Up Payment]. The maximum amount you can top up through this method is 30 PLN. This option is only available for completed transactions.

tytul: How to Pay for an Item Purchased on Allegro
naglowek: How to Make a Payment for an Item Purchased on Allegro
tekst:
If you've bought an item on Allegro, you'll need to pay for it. Here's how:
1. After placing your order, navigate to the [My Orders] section.
2. Find the order you want to pay for and click on it.
3. Choose the payment method. Common options include:
   - Direct payment (e.g., Allegro Smart!, Allegro Pay)
   - Payment through a bank account (e.g., online transfer)
   - Payment through a third-party service (e.g., PayPal)
4. Follow the instructions for the chosen payment method. For example, if you choose Direct Payment, you'll be redirected to a secure page where you can pay using your credit card or other approved method.
5. After completing the payment, you should receive a confirmation message. Keep this in case you need to reference it later.

**Troubleshooting Common Issues**

### Q: Can I make a payment if I don't have a bank account or my bank doesn't support online payments?
A: Yes. You can use the **Transfer** method. When you choose Transfer, you'll be given the bank details and amount to transfer. You can do this at a post office or bank. Ensure you note down the details carefully and make the transfer within 30 days of the purchase.

### Q: What if I make a mistake when transferring money?
A: Always double-check the details before making a transfer. If you make a mistake, contact the seller or Allegro's customer support immediately. They can help resolve the issue and ensure the payment is credited to the correct account.

### Q: Can I split my payment for multiple items from the same order?
A: No. You can only make one payment for an entire order. If you want to pay for multiple items, you'll need to place separate orders.

### Q: Is there a limit to how much I can pay by transfer?
A: Yes. The maximum amount you can pay by transfer is 30 zł. This limit is in place to protect both buyers and sellers.

### Q: How long does it take for the seller to receive my payment after a transfer?
A: Normally, the seller receives the funds within 3-5 business days after the transfer is complete. This can vary depending on the bank and the seller's specific payment processing system.

### Q: What if I have more questions or need help?
A: Allegro's Help Center and customer support are here to assist you. You can find detailed guides and FAQs on the [Allegro Help Center]. If you need further help, contact [Allegro Customer Support] via phone, chat, or email.

If additional identity verification is required, we will contact you via email. You will also see this request in your Allegro Pay panel. Do not send us your photos or ID documents without our request.

How to verify your identity

photos of both sides of your ID card
a photo of your face – a selfie taken with your phone will suffice.

Privacy Policy of Allegro Pay Sp. z o. o.

ID card

must belong to you
must be an official and current document issued in the territory of the Republic of Poland
must not be damaged.

be original and taken in a way that allows clear identification of the document and your face.

tekst:
We can ask for your photo and photo of your ID in Allegro Pay when:

We need to verify that you are the owner of the ID we received and the Allegro Pay account.

To verify your identity, we need:

A photo of your ID (National ID of Poland)
A photo of your face

Please follow these steps to provide the photos:

1. **Take photos of both sides of your National ID (ID of Poland)**
   - The photo must be original and in color. We do not accept scans or edited photos made in graphic programs.
   - The photo must be clear and legible.
   - The photo must show the entire ID, including all four corners and sides.

2. **Take a photo of your face**
   - Make sure the photo is taken in a well-lit area.
   - Ensure the photo is clear and shows your unobstructed face (without dark glasses or other items that could make it difficult to recognize you).
   - If you wear a head covering due to religious or cultural reasons, you can include a photo with the head covering. However, you must also provide a photo without the head covering.

3. **Send the photos**
   - Go to the [Contact page](https://allegro.pl/kontakt).
   - In the message window, write your request.
   - Click on [Choose a way to contact] – to attach a file with the photo, select the option
     **Send by email**.
   - Use the [drag or add file] option to add the photos. Enter the email address associated with your Allegro account and Allegro Pay service.
   - Click [Send by email].

**What happens when you submit your photos?**

Once you submit your photos, our team will review them. If everything is in order, you will receive a confirmation message. If we need more information or if there are any issues with the photos, we will contact you. We will do everything we can to process your request as quickly as possible.

What happens when you make a partial payment before the deadline specified in the agreement

greater than the installment specified in the schedule, but

tytul: What is a Split Payment?
naglowek: Learn About Split Payments and How to Pay for Your Purchases Using This Method.
tekst:
Find out what split payments are and how to pay for your purchases using this method.
What is a Split Payment
According to Polish law, as of November 1, 2019, certain purchases can only be paid for using split payments (known as split payment in English).
Split payments involve splitting the payment for an invoice into two parts: the net amount and the VAT tax, which is paid to a separate VAT account.
To allow buyers and sellers to settle their accounts according to the law, Allegro also uses split payments.
When a transaction is subject to the obligation of split payment
This happens when:
the buyer and seller are VAT taxpayers
the transaction involves the purchase of items in one of the categories specified in
Attachment No. 15 to the Act on Taxes on Goods and Services
the invoice amount, including delivery, is 15,000 PLN gross or exceeds this amount.
When you use split payment
If the value of your shopping cart from one seller is 15,000 PLN gross together with delivery and more – then you will see split payment next to other payment methods.
If you choose to pay for your order using split payment, the seller should issue you a receipt for the purchase or send the necessary data for the transfer (including the gross amount and the VAT amount).
How to Pay Using Split Payment
To pay for your order using split payment, follow these steps:
1. Add the items you want to buy to your shopping cart from the seller who requires split payment.
2. When you proceed to checkout, you will see the option for split payment along with other payment methods.
3. Select split payment as your preferred method of payment.
4. The seller will provide you with the necessary details for the payment, including the gross amount and VAT amount.
5. Follow the seller's instructions to complete the payment using the provided details.
Remember, split payments are designed to help buyers and sellers comply with tax regulations. If you have any questions or concerns, don't hesitate to contact Allegro's customer service.

How to Pay with Split Payment
To pay for your order using Split Payment, you transfer the payment for the purchases to the seller's account, according to the seller's instructions. Then the seller can manually change the order status in the Orders tab.
The seller must independently evaluate whether the invoice is subject to Split Payment requirements, in accordance with the law.

tytul: Transfers of Unpaid Debts - Information for Customers
tekst:
Transfers of debts relate to Allegro Pay agreements, where the payment term for at least one installment has already passed and the collection of the debt has proven ineffective. So, if you stop paying installments on your Allegro Pay agreement and the collection efforts are unsuccessful, we may transfer the ownership of such an agreement to a securitization fund.
What is a debt transfer
A debt transfer means that the debt from your Allegro Pay agreement has been purchased by a securitization fund from Allegro Pay sp. z o.o. You will then pay the Allegro Pay agreement to the securitization fund, to the bank account indicated by the fund, rather than to Allegro Pay sp. z o.o. The securitization fund has the right to demand payment from you for the obligation under the Allegro Pay Agreement.
What is a securitization fund
A securitization fund is a entity that specializes in purchasing debts from other entities.
Information about your current debt status, the payment account, and the fund's details will be provided directly by the new administrator in the communication you receive.
The debt transfer is regulated by Art. 509 of the Civil Code. According to this article, the creditor - Allegro Pay sp. z o.o. - can transfer the debt to a third party, namely a securitization fund, without the debtor's consent.
Information about debt transfer
If the debt is transferred to a securitization fund, you will be notified through the Allegro Pay panel - we will display the appropriate notification.

ierzytelności
If a claim is transferred to a securitization fund, you will be notified through the Allegro Pay panel - we will display an appropriate message. You will also receive a notification about the transfer (sale) from the new creditor.
What changes with the transfer of claims
The transfer of a claim means that:
data claim is no longer the property of Allegro Pay
the securitization fund has the right to demand repayment of the obligation resulting from the Allegro Pay agreement
the agreement to which the claim was transferred is no longer serviced by Allegro Pay
if a claim is transferred, you cannot enter into new Allegro Pay agreements.
Payment of the agreement after the transfer of a claim
If a claim is transferred to a fund, you will pay it to an account number indicated by the fund. You cannot make payments for the agreement through the Allegro Pay service panel.
If you have questions about transferred claims, please direct them to the securitization fund. Contact details can also be found in communication from the new administrator.

naglowek: What does it mean to reserve your PESEL number and how it works
tekst:
What does it mean to reserve your PESEL number and how it works
According to Polish law, you can reserve your PESEL number so that no one can use it without your knowledge. As of June 1, 2024, financial institutions are required to check whether a PESEL number is reserved, for example, when signing a loan or credit agreement.
When you reserve your PESEL number, it will be added to the
PESEL Reservation Register
. If needed, you can revoke the reservation, and then reserve your PESEL number again.

You can check this in the mObywatel app or on the website
mObywatel.gov.pl
- just log in to your profile.

The PESEL Reservation Register
- is a database managed by the Ministry of Digitization that contains information about reserved PESEL numbers. You can learn more about this topic on the
website of the Ministry of Digitization
.
Reserving a PESEL number
- means reporting your PESEL number to the PESEL Reservation Register. When your PESEL number is reserved, you cannot enter into certain agreements, for example, an agreement for the Allegro Pay service.
Revocating the reservation of a PESEL number
- means removing your PESEL number from the PESEL Reservation Register. When you revoke the reservation, you can enter into an agreement for the Allegro Pay service and make purchases with Allegro Pay.
Visit the government website and learn more about reserving your PESEL number.

naglowek: What does reservation of PESEL number mean when you use Allegro Pay?
tekst:
Reservation of PESEL number

What does reservation of PESEL number mean when you use Allegro Pay
Because we are a financing provider, as per the law from 1 June 2024, we are obliged to verify the reservation of your PESEL number. We will do this during the activation of Allegro Pay by you and later, when we conclude certain agreements with you—for example, during some purchases made with Allegro Pay.
If your Allegro Pay service agreement was concluded
before 1 June 2024
, the law does not apply to you. This means that we will not check if your PESEL is reserved.
In which situations we will check if your PESEL is reserved
From 1 June 2024, when you conclude an agreement for an Allegro Pay service, we will check if your PESEL is reserved:
during the activation of the Allegro Pay service itself, and later
when concluding certain agreements with Allegro Pay—for example, during some purchases made with Allegro Pay
when consolidating or changing a credit agreement from Allegro Pay to an installment one.
If your PESEL is reserved, you will not be able to perform any of the above actions. We will let you know.

tytul: What you can write in the comments for a purchase
tekst:
When you rate a purchase from a seller, you can add a comment. It should contain information about:
the product you bought – for example, its condition or whether it matches the description in the offer
the course of the purchase – for example, the time it took to ship the product or your contact with the seller.
What you can't write in the comment
Vulgar language, obscene or pornographic content, or content promoting hate, racism, xenophobia or conflict between nations.
Injurious content (expressions that, according to the dictionary of the Polish language, have the qualifier "injurious", "disparaging" or "insulting") –
only if they concern the seller,
not the product being offered.
Words such as: thief, fraudster, swindler, deceitful, crook, hustler, swindler, fraud, crime/criminal, trickster, schemer, hooligan – towards persons who have not been convicted by a final judgment, because
they may infringe on personal rights and freedoms.
Contacts of buyers and sellers (including name, surname, place of residence, phone number or e-mail address).
Content of a purely promotional nature and commercial information.
Website addresses.

tytul: What to do if you're waiting for a consignment for too long
tekst: If you're waiting for a consignment for too long, first check whether the seller has actually sent it. To do this, go to the My purchases tab. Next to the relevant order, click [view order details] and check the consignment status. If you don't see any information about the consignment status or the seller hasn't sent it yet, check: whether you entered the correct data in the delivery and payment form, and whether the seller received your payment. If you're sure that everything was done correctly on your side, contact the seller. Ask for an explanation of the delay and, if the seller claims that the consignment has already been sent, ask for the tracking number or proof of posting. What to do if the problem isn't resolved or the seller doesn't respond You can open a discussion. As the reason, select I didn't receive the product. You can do this no earlier than 1 hour and no later than 2 years after purchasing. The seller has 24 hours to respond. If they don't, click on Request Allegro's assistance - this will involve us in the discussion. Learn how to start a discussion. If the consignment arrives after you've opened a discussion, we'll let you know by e-mail. If you don't have any objections to the order you received, we'll close the discussion after 24 hours. If you're unable to reach an agreement

tytul: What you can do when you're waiting for a delivery too long
tekst:
If you don't have any objections to the order you receive, we'll close the Discussion after 24 hours. If you can't reach an agreement with the seller, you can mark the Discussion as unresolved. We'll then send you a link to a short application for compensation under Allegro Buyer Protection.
What to do in other cases
If the parcel doesn't arrive by the estimated delivery date we showed you when you made the purchase - you'll see the 'delivery delayed' information for this order. If in the order details you see information that the courier attempted delivery but was unsuccessful (for example, they didn't find you at home) - contact the carrier directly. Also, check if the messages from the carrier (SMS, email) contain the direct contact phone number to the courier who is responsible for delivering your parcel - then contact them directly.
If in the order details you see information that your parcel has been collected but you don't have it - make sure that someone else didn't collect it, for example, a person you live with, a neighbour or - if you order a parcel to a company - a receptionist or security personnel at the building.

tytul: What do the Discussion statuses mean
tekst:
We mark each Discussion with an appropriate status:
In progress
– any Discussion started between 1 and 14 days that has not been marked as resolved or unresolved.
Resolved
– a Discussion that the buyer has marked as resolved and closed. If the buyer does not mark the Discussion within 30 days, we will automatically assign this status.
Unresolved
– a Discussion that the buyer has marked as unresolved. The buyer can change its status to resolved at any time.

tytul: What happens if you don't pay for your order
tekst:
When you confirm a purchase in an offer or win an auction, you automatically enter into a contract with the seller - i.e., you undertake to pay and collect the purchased item. If for any reason you don't pay for your purchase, we may
automatically cancel your order
.

If you made an order by mistake, you can cancel it yourself - provided the seller has not yet started fulfilling it.
Find out more
.

When we automatically cancel your purchase
We automatically cancel orders that have not been paid for within the specified time. This applies only to orders where you choose the option of prepayment.
We will cancel your unpaid order:
after 7 days - if you buy using the 'Buy now' option or in an auction and choose a payment method other than a traditional bank transfer
after 14 days - if you buy using the 'Buy now' option or in an auction and choose prepayment
by traditional bank transfer
.
The seller
may set their own deadline
after which we will automatically cancel your purchase. This applies to both 'Buy now' offers and auctions. The time set by the seller may not be shorter than 7 days or longer than 30 days.
We will inform you by email when we cancel one of your orders.
What happens if you abandon your purchase again

tytul: What happens if you don't pay for your order
tekst:
We take care of ensuring that transactions on Allegro are safe. We constantly monitor them using our internal tools. If you frequently abandon your purchases, we may ask for additional explanations.
If you fail to pay for an item or refuse to accept a cash-on-delivery shipment for the second time, the seller may also consider that you are doing it intentionally and ask us for help. We will then check if you are violating the Allegro regulations. To avoid misunderstandings, it is best to agree with the seller on any delay in payment or abandonment of the purchase.

You can find more information on how to follow our rules in
Article 10.1 of the regulations.

tytul: What is the product list and how to use it
tekst:
We display the product list on the search results page or the category page. You can use the search feature to sort by: relevance, price, popularity, or product rating. In sorting by relevance, we try to match the order of products on the list as closely as possible to what you are looking for.

tytul: What you need to know about trading in antiques
tekst:
Archaeological monuments and cultural assets are subject to legal protection. Therefore, great caution is required when purchasing or selling them. Participating in the illegal trading of an antique item can result in legal consequences.
If you plan to buy or sell an antique item on Allegro, remember that:
assessing the actual material, historical, and artistic value of an antique requires a great deal of knowledge. Fakes may be among the items offered online as antiques, so it is advisable to consult an expert to ensure that the item is original.
offers of antique items that come from theft or were obtained in any other unlawful manner (e.g., found as a result of excavations carried out without permission) are illegal.
Polish law prohibits exporting
some antiques
abroad without obtaining the appropriate permits.
according to Article 20 of the Museum Act, a registered museum has the right of first refusal to purchase an antique sold at an auction. The museum must submit a statement regarding the exercise of the right of first refusal immediately after the antique is bid on, but no later than the end of the entire auction.
a registered museum also has the right of first refusal to purchase from entities whose business is to offer antiques for sale,

tytul: What you need to know about trading antiques
tekst:
.
A registered museum also has the right of first refusal to purchase from entities engaged in activities involving the offering for sale of antiques, within 14 days from the date of the museum's notification of its intention to purchase. In the event that the right of first refusal is exercised, the registered museum shall acquire the antique at the price valid at the time of notifying the intention to purchase.
What does the buyer need to know about trading antiques?
You can only purchase antiques and cultural property from legal owners.

To confirm this, you can ask the Seller to document their right to dispose of the item in the listing. You can also check the origin of the item by asking the Seller to present, for example, a proof of purchase of the antique or other documentation confirming its legal origin.
If you have any doubts, check whether the item is listed in the
National Register of Stolen or Illegally Exported Antiques
, maintained by the Centre for the Protection of Public Collections, and confirm its legality through Interpol's National Bureau, UNESCO or ICOM. You can also contact the National Task Force for Combating Crimes against National Heritage of the Chief Inspectorate of Police:
dziedzictwonarodowe@policja.gov.pl
If an antique is offered in a way that should raise doubts and you do not check the legality of the offer before purchasing,

tekst:

If an antique item is offered in a way that should raise doubts, and you do not check the legality of the offer before buying, you may be accused of failing to comply with the condition of buying in good faith and held liable. If you have information about the sale of antiques from an illegal source or reasonable doubts about the authenticity of the items, please contact us
.
If a registered museum exercises its right of first refusal or right of first purchase, despite winning the auction, you will not have grounds to demand the seller finalize the transaction. The seller, in accordance with the law, will not be able to sell the item to you.
What should a seller know about trading antiques?
A buyer may ask you to prove that you have the right to sell an antique item or an item classified as a cultural good and to submit documents confirming the legality of the origin of the antique offered.
If you discover such an item in Poland or find it by chance or as a result of archaeological searches, you will not automatically become its owner. Under Polish law, the owner of such items is the Treasury, so finders do not have the right to sell them.
Offering fake antiques or altering antiques to mislead the buyer about the value of the item is also a crime.

A sale made in violation of the right of first refusal or purchase is invalid.

How we calculate the percentage of recommendations
We calculate it according to the following formula:
Percentage of recommendations = (number of unique 'Recommend' assessments from the last 12 months ÷ (number of unique 'Recommend' assessments from the last 12 months + number of unique 'Do not recommend' assessments from the last 12 months)) x 100
We round the result to one decimal place – for example:
0.99950 x 100 = 99.950 ≈ 100%
0.99949 x 100 = 99.949 ≈ 99.9%.

What is the minimum price
The minimum price is the lowest amount the seller is willing to sell the listed item for.
If no buyer offers an amount equal to or higher than the minimum price, the item will not be sold.
The minimum price is hidden until a buyer offers an amount higher than the minimum price.
If you see the message
Minimum price not reached
the auction is in one of the following situations:
No offers have been placed
No offers reach or exceed the minimum price set by the seller
In such cases, no offers placed are binding.
If at least one offer meets or exceeds the minimum price, the message will disappear.
From that point on, that offer and all subsequent offers are binding.
If the amount you bid meets or exceeds the minimum price, the system will automatically increase your offer to the minimum price.

The current price in the ongoing auction is 5 PLN. Your maximum offer is 15 PLN, and the minimum price set by the seller is 8 PLN. In this situation, the system will set your offer at 8 PLN, and the message

will disappear from the item page.

Who can sell over-the-counter medicines
To be able to offer over-the-counter medicines, a seller must:
run a business as a pharmacy or pharmaceutical outlet
provide the full contact details of the pharmacy and the pharmacy manager
provide the licence number for running the pharmacy, along with the details of the Pharmaceutical Inspectorate that issued the licence
undergo detailed verification (including in the National Pharmacy Register)
conclude a special agreement with Allegro to create a pharmacy account for pharmacies and pharmaceutical outlets.
Only verified pharmacies and pharmaceutical outlets may sell over-the-counter medicines on Allegro
. Each offer from a pharmacy has a common logo at the bottom of the page - a symbol introduced by the European Commission in 2014 to indicate pharmacies that legally sell medicines at a distance. The common logo is a white cross on a green background.

Are non-prescription medications original
Non-prescription medications sold on Allegro are the exact same as those available in, for example, brick-and-mortar pharmacies and pharmaceutical outlets. Since only authorized sellers can sell them, you can be sure they take care of the originality and highest quality of the products they offer on Allegro.
Can you return a non-prescription medication you’ve bought
Once the medication is dispensed from a pharmacy or pharmaceutical outlet, it generally cannot be returned. The main reason for this is
safety of patients
. After the medication leaves the pharmacy or pharmaceutical outlet, the seller loses control over the storage conditions (for example, whether it was exposed to sunlight, moisture, or extreme temperatures). Such a product, when returned, could pose a threat to the next person who buys it.
This regulation applies to both prescription and non-prescription (OTC) medications.
Exceptions:
The medication has a manufacturing defect – for example, a damaged package
the pharmacy dispensed a different medication or dosage
you suspect the medication is counterfeit – report such a case directly to the pharmacy and the pharmaceutical inspectorate.

When you buy a beverage in a container subject to the deposit system, a deposit will be added to the price of the product. The deposit amount is always clearly visible next to the product price and in the order summary.

Deposit amount

0.50 PLN – for single-use plastic bottles (HDPE or PET) and metal cans

How to redeem the deposit
You can redeem the full deposit amount.

Which products are subject to deposit?
The deposit system covers beverages intended for direct consumption in plastic, glass, or metal cans.

Example products excluded from deposit

Not all beverages are subject to deposit. This means that the same products may be available on the market with and without deposit (for example, from older production batches or from import).

In another offer, you buy a set consisting of 12 units of a 1-liter drink. We display the price of the set and the deposit amount for each unit, i.e., 12x1 PLN = 12 PLN.

tytul: How to biometrically confirm purchases and payments in the Allegro app
tekst:
Biometric confirmation ensures that only you can make purchases in your Allegro app - no one else can approve them. You can use your biometric data:
face scan,
or
fingerprint.
Biometric confirmation can be used when purchasing with 'buy now' or the '[I buy and pay]' button.
How it works
When biometric confirmation is enabled in the Allegro app, you can approve purchases and payments:
Allegro Pay
using your fingerprint or face scan.
This means you don't need to enter SMS codes every time you pay with Allegro Pay. You will confirm the payment using your face scan or fingerprint. You will only need to use the SMS code once - during the first payment with biometric confirmation. After that, it will not be necessary anymore.
When you can use biometric confirmation
You can use biometric confirmation in the Allegro app when:
your phone recognizes faces or scans fingerprints (and you have this function enabled in your phone settings),
you have the appropriate version of the Allegro app installed on your phone:
6.16.0 or newer - for devices with iOS,
7.36.0 or newer - for devices with Android (version 11 or higher),
you have biometric confirmation enabled in the Allegro app.

Open the app

tekst:

tytul: I'm a buyer. What does sorting by relevance mean
tekst:
Relevance is
the default sorting of the list of offers.

In sorting by relevance, we try to match the order of offers on the list as closely as possible to what you are looking for.
This means that for two very similar queries for a product - for example, 'iPhone 11' and 'iphone', you may see a different order of offers on the list.
Several factors influence this:
the query you define when searching for an item - for example, a phrase you enter in the search bar, filters you select, categories you choose
the match between the title of the offer and the search phrase
the behavior of other users on the lists of offers, for example, which offers they searched for, viewed, purchased, etc.
What we take into account in sorting by relevance

the first photo

the seller has filled in the mandatory parameters
the seller has listed the offer in the correct category

the offer is part of a multi-variant offer

tytul: When can we intervene in feedback given to a seller

If any of the following situations apply to you and you want us to remove the feedback, please contact us. Click [contact us] at the bottom of this article. Feedback given in exchange for a benefit In accordance with our regulations: sellers may not persuade you to give or change your feedback in exchange for a benefit (such as a discount, free product, voucher, or money). you may not make a purchase solely in order to give feedback - in other words, to manipulate ratings or for a financial or other benefit. This means that, among other things, the following are considered breaches of the regulations: the seller includes an additional product with the parcel and a card asking for feedback, the seller asks you to change the comments and offers a discount on your next purchase in return, the seller asks you to remove the comments and offers a refund for your purchase in return, you are expecting a discount on your next purchase in return for giving or changing your feedback. If we receive a report of such breaches, we may remove the feedback or take other action. We do not consider the following to be breaches, including situations where: the seller includes a card with the parcel thanking you for your purchase and asking for feedback, the seller includes a card with the parcel thanking you for your feedback and asking for a review, sellers may not persuade you to give or change your feedback in exchange for a benefit (such as a discount, free product, voucher, or money).

tytul: Discover Allegro One Box - our parcel lockers
tekst:
We have built our own delivery network and placed Allegro One Box parcel lockers. You can use them as part of
Allegro Delivery
– our delivery partnership program. The Allegro One Box parcel lockers were created in cooperation with local communities and are accessible to people with visual impairments and those who are blind.
Why did we set up our own parcel lockers
We want to give you more choice when it comes to delivery options, and thus meet the growing demand for fast and convenient parcel delivery.
What have we done so far? As of May 25, 2021, the
Allegro One Punkt
network has been operating. This means that customers can collect their parcels at around 2,000 points - Kolporter kiosks, epaka.pl, Furgonetka, Auchan, Pakersi and Bonito delivery points.
Where can you find an Allegro parcel locker
You can find all available parcel lockers using
naszą wyszukiwarkę
.
What sets Allegro One Box apart
Our lockers are powered by mains electricity
– but Allegro purchases energy that is certified by the supplier as coming from wind and/or water power. These certificates show that the ordered volume of wind and/or water energy has been fed into the energy network to meet the power needs of our One Box lockers.
Some lockers are also powered by solar energy (off-grid version)
– the photovoltaic panels built into the lockers use solar energy. Thanks to

Powered by solar energy (

Energy storage
– thanks to robust batteries, the machines operate 24 hours a day (also at night and in low temperatures, for example in winter).
Air quality sensors
– if you use the Allegro app, you can add information about air quality in the area to the home screen of your smartphone or tablet. You can also check the measurement results on the
maps of locations
.
Greenery
– wherever possible, the back wall of the machine is exposed and planted with greenery, which we take care of regularly. We plant greenery on one, two or three sides of the machine - depending on what is possible in a given location. That's why each machine is different and the plantings are tailored to each location. We plant when the plants have a chance to take root and grow, i.e., in spring, summer and early autumn.
Standby mode
- the machines do not work when you don't need them and wake up when you approach with the app, use the
Press to Start button
or the screen.
Care for delivery quality
– we take care of the way couriers work in the area of the device and precisely designate the unloading areas.
Thoughtful design
– when creating the design for our machines, we

tytul: Estimated delivery time of your shipment
tekst: In each offer on Allegro and at the most important stages of the purchase, we display the estimated delivery time. This tells you approximately when your parcel will arrive at your place, pickup point, or parcel locker. The estimated delivery time is made up of: shipping time - the estimated time the seller needs to prepare the shipment from the moment they receive payment for the item or from the moment they receive a statement of payment (in the case of purchase with shipment paid on delivery) until they send the item. When calculating the estimated delivery time, we take into account the shipping time declared by the seller in the offers and/or the actual shipping time (historical data). transit time - the time it takes for the carrier to deliver the parcel to you. How we calculate the estimated delivery time In addition to shipping and transit times, when calculating the estimated delivery time, we also take into account, among other things: seasonality of sales, cutoff times for same-day shipping, place of shipping, place of delivery. The estimated delivery time is calculated based on the data available. It may differ from the actual delivery time, as we do not take into account random events or unplanned delays in our calculations - either on the part of sellers or carriers. Where to see the estimated delivery time We display the estimated delivery time separately for each offer and

tytul: Wholesale discount on Allegro Business - what is it and how to use it
tekst:
The wholesale discount on Allegro Business allows you to purchase larger orders at a reduced price. Learn how it works and how to take advantage of it.
What is the wholesale discount and how does it work
The wholesale discount is a special discount offered by sellers on Allegro Business. It allows you to pay less when purchasing a larger quantity of a product. Sellers set the discount thresholds themselves - the more you buy, the greater the discount you receive.

If you buy at least 20 units, you will receive a 5% discount. When purchasing 50 units, the discount can increase to 10%, and with 100 units, it can reach up to 25%.

Who can use wholesale discounts
Wholesale discounts are exclusively for buying businesses that make purchases on Allegro Business. To use them, log in to your account and select [on company] - we will then transfer you to Allegro Business.
Learn more about
switching from a private to a business view.

Searching:
when browsing offers on Allegro Business, look for the special wholesale discount marking.
In the
Business discounts
section on Allegro Business:
you will find offers with a wholesale discount.

purchasing on Allegro Business.

1 hour after purchase – after this time, the buyer can start a Discussion.

How it works
If you buy a product that the seller sends to you from outside the European Union, your purchase is settled as
import of goods
in accordance with the applicable regulations.
The ordered shipment with the imported goods may be subject to customs control. As a result of such control,
you may have to pay VAT and customs duty
. VAT will be charged according to the rate applicable in the country to which you are ordering.

You can be a VAT payer as a private individual, even if you are buying for private purposes.

What it means for you
If you buy a product from outside the European Union,
declare it for customs clearance to the customs authorities
in accordance with the applicable regulations. You can do this personally or through a representative. Often, courier companies offer this service.
In the declaration,
calculate the customs duties and taxes due
takie as VAT or excise duty. You will do this based on the shipment documentation - for example, based on the invoice. If the product comes from mail order sales, the declaration should be in writing (often electronic form is allowed).

They may pay particular attention to the value of the goods you declare and their classification. During verification, the customs authority may request additional documents from you, such as proof of payment or the offer from which the goods come.
How to avoid fees
Before buying goods abroad,
carefully review the terms of the transaction.
Pay attention to the country from which the seller is sending the shipment.
Also, check the delivery conditions provided by the courier company and whether it offers settlement with the customs authority - these services may be additional paid services.
If you have doubts, consult the Customs Office or a tax advisor.
Familiarize yourself with Polish regulations and other sources of information
about importing goods into Poland. If you have doubts, consult an expert in this field before buying.
